mentions.name: Turingo
mentions.description: AI detection tool that analyzes the writing process rather than the final draft. It tracks unusual changes, including pastes, throughout the full revision history to give teachers a clearer picture of how much AI-generated text is present at any time, so they can discuss it with a student before jumping to accusations.
mentions.problem: Teachers have no reliable way to gauge how much AI text went into a student's writing and risk jumping to accusations.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Turingo: https://turingo.net

  AI detection based on writing process and not the final draft. It tracks unusual changes, including pastes, throughout the full revision history, giving teachers a clearer picture of how much AI text is there at any time. The idea is to help them have a conversation with a student before jumping to accusations.
mentions.author: mtrx
